_comment: Ordering steps we confirmed by walking the flow ourselves. These override or extend what a page's marketing copy happens to admit. Every entry needs a source and the date it was seen.

Lotus Weight Loss.note: assessment is gated by a consent declaration (T&Cs + patient consent form), then a two-screen consultation (Assessment -> Image Upload -> Details); the image upload step accepts files or a camera capture, so a photo is required before the pharmacy will prescribe
